why: [R-COC-01] with the ratchet of [R-ENF-02]. Every study on disk when engine/cost_of_capital.py was adopted (02-Sep-2026) carries either a flat rate or a schedule built inline; each is allowed to fail while it waits its turn. AMOC alone implements the procedure, and even its record predates this module's shape. The build breaks on a NEW study with no entry either way, or on a listed study whose record has appeared and is wrong. The list may only SHORTEN (--prune).
